Script:


THROWFORWARD | KRUGER MILLIONS

VISUALS SCRIPT



Montage of photos …

VO: She was a beloved friend…. a confidante…


UPSOUND TIMECODE: 03:57
Two, three times a day on the phone. Best friends, we did hunting together, going on vacations together. Very, very close friend…

VO: … and the accountant they trusted to handle their finances


LINK 3:30 – It’s scary how much an accountant knows about their clients. They have their identity documents, their company records, the keys to their bank accounts … but most of all, they have their trust.


VO: Paid to act in their best interests, to safeguard their assets and wind up the estates of loved ones who’d died she instead had other ideas.

Timecode: 01:23 – 01:35
This is one of the correspondences I have from her regarding mom’s estate where she basically tells me that “look, we have to be patient. It takes long for SARS.”

G: That was obviously just a delaying tactic.

That was a delaying tactic.


TIMECODE: 4:25
This is the executor letter that’s been falsified. This is the one we sent through to the masters office and they said to us, thee number on that is not on their system. My mother’s estate hasn’t even been registered.


VO: It’s alleged she helped herself to her client’s cash.


UPSOUND TIMECODE 4:49
I always found it difficult to understand how she could maintain that lifestyle that she was living…


VO: Now this highflyer with a penchant for trophy hunts, is in the sights of a financial sleuth…


UPSOUND Timecode: 02:18 – 02:32
I got a phone call from an investigator indicating that they ere busy unearthing severe problems especially regarding trust money.


UPSOUND TIMECODE: 2:57
G: You opened a can of worms.
Investigator: I think one could say so, yes.


VO: On an upcoming episode of Carte Blanche ….


Montage of Govan walking around…




VO: … we investigate a trusted accountant alleged to have duped her clients…

….by abusing their trust, their personal information…

UPSOUND TIMECODE: 09:34 – 9:41
I’ve never signed anything. If you look at the IDs that she used, it’s my ID but not my photo.

VO:… and their bank accounts …

UPSOUND TIME`CODE: 11:29
I was a facebook friend her, I recall very flamboyant expeditions of deep-sea fishing… big game hunting, so I thought – life is good here. It’s only later that I realized that probably we were sponsoring some of these trips
